language.map_marker: <svg viewBox="-2 -2 32 32" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><circle cx="14" cy="14" r="13" fill="#AB8900" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/></svg>

references.source:
Fran Woods\.
Halbi – english dictionary\.
Webonary\.org, 2019\.
Web edition of a lexicon compiled among Raj Mureas at Bhatpal village, Bastar, by Fran Woods and Betsy Schuyler \(1967–1969\) and by Woods on field trips \(1971–1978\)\. Devanagari headwords with phonemic IPA citation forms, English and Hindi definitions, illustrative sentences, SIL semantic\-domain codes and typed variant, complex\-form and cross\-reference relations\. SIL Language \\\\& Culture Archives entry 84724 reported 7,556 entries at publication; the 2026\-08\-26 crawl of the live edition yields 7,788 distinct entry GUIDs\.
URL: [https://www\.webonary\.org/halbi/](https://www.webonary.org/halbi/)\.
references.progress: 7,773 of the 7,788 entries rendered by the vernacular browse index: every record carrying a headword, an IPA citation form, and either a definition or a variant-of relation. Fifteen records are excluded and accounted for in the audit --- 7 with no citation form, 7 with neither definition nor relation, and 1 whose citation-form field holds Devanagari. Example sentences, pictures and audio are not installed
references.provenance: Crawled from the paginated FLEx XHTML browse export on 2026-08-26 with data/other/forms/raw_data/woods_halbi.py; 364 pages cached under tmp/webonary-halbi-cache and rebuildable offline.
